correctness.rationale: With deg Q=m>=1, all Q-roots on unit circle, deg P<=m, the m-reversal satisfies Q#=κQ with |κ|=1, hence on circle overline(P/Q) Q²=κ^{-1}QP#, a nonsingular polynomial. For F_j=z^jQ², the adjoint Toeplitz operator T_barφ maps it to κ^{-1}z^jQP#; this polynomial belongs to domain T_φ and maps further to κ^{-1}z^jPP#. The de Branges–Rovnyak norm identity <f,g>_H(b)=<f,g>_H²+<T_barφ f,T_barφ g> yields <F_j,z^k>=coefficient w_{k-j} of W=Q²+κ^{-1}PP#. In finite monomial Gram M_N, all rows j<=N-2m of Q(B_N)²M_N coincide with upper Toeplitz band T_N(W); last 2m rows differ and residual rank<=2m. Handles repeated poles, complex coefficients, P=0, N>=2m; no assumption that original M_N is banded.
